name: a temperature printed as a whole number, the run's error not estimated: half a kelvin, and said so
worked: no run error was handed; the last printed digit is a unit of 1, half of it 0.5

name: a drag coefficient printed to ten decimals and a run that resolves far less, its error from three or more grids: the run's error as it is
worked: half the last printed digit is 5e-11; the run's error 0.002, estimated over three or more grids, enters with factor 1 and is larger, so it is the tolerance

name: the same drag coefficient with its error from two grids: three times the run's error
worked: a two-grid estimate enters three times over: 3 x 0.002 = 0.006, larger than half the last printed digit 5e-11, so 0.006 is the tolerance

name: a wavelength printed to one decimal and a run more precise than that, over three or more grids: half the digit
worked: half the last printed digit is 0.05; the run's error 0.01 enters with factor 1 and is smaller, so 0.05 is the tolerance

name: a transmission printed to two decimals and a two-grid error whose triple outweighs half the digit
worked: half the last printed digit is 0.005; the two-grid error 0.002 alone would lose to it, but it enters three times over, 0.006, which is larger, so 0.006 is the tolerance

name: a standard error of a series keeps no factor
worked: half the last printed digit is 0.05; a series' standard error 0.07 enters with factor 1 and is larger, so 0.07 is the tolerance

name: a stated uncertainty is taken before the digits and the run's error
worked: the source states 0.0001, so that is the tolerance, whatever the digits or the run

name: a reference that is not a number gives none
worked: the text is not a number, so no way of the rule gives a tolerance

name: a run's error handed without saying how it was estimated gives none
worked: the factor depends on how the error was estimated, and nothing says, so no way of the rule gives a tolerance

name: an analytic centreline velocity, exact, its run's error from two grids: three times the run's error, no half digit
worked: the reference is exact, so half its last printed digit (0.05) does not apply; 3 * 0.0002 = 0.0006

name: an exact spectral line of a defined transition, its run's error from three grids: the run's error as it is
an exact reference with no run error estimated: no tolerance, and said why
worked: exact, so the half digit (0.5) does not apply, and no run error was handed: nothing gives a tolerance

name: no stated uncertainty and a span from materials: the span is the acceptance interval, before the digits
worked: no uncertainty is stated and a span [2.93, 2.97] is handed: it is given as the interval, and half the last printed digit, 5e-10, is not reached

name: a span is taken before a run's error that was estimated
worked: the span [502.1, 502.6] comes before the last branch, so the run's error 0.01 and the half digit 0.05 are not weighed

name: a stated uncertainty is taken before a span
worked: the source states 0.0001, which is the tolerance; the span [0.47, 0.49] is not reached

name: a span with one edge is no span and gives none
worked: only the low edge 0.3 is handed: a span has two edges, so nothing is given, and no later branch is taken in its place

name: an exact reference with a span: the span, since it comes before the last branch
worked: the span [1064, 1069] is handed and comes before the branch where an exact reference takes the run's error alone
